text.en:
The name of the Southern Leyte Agro-Fisheries Technical Institute in the Municipality of
Bontoc, Province of Southern Leyte, is changed to Ruperto K. Kangleon Memorial Agro-Fisheries Technical

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: December 3, 1985
